policies.outbound:
<emit-metric name="TotalTokens" value="@{
            var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            var usage = body?["usage"] as JObject;
            var inTok  = (int?)usage?["input_tokens"] ?? 0;
            var outTok = (int?)usage?["output_tokens"] ?? 0;
            return (double)(inTok + outTok);
        }" namespace="enterprise-ai-gateway">
            
            
            
            <dimension name="Model"      value="@{ var b = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true); return (string)(b?["model"] ?? "unknown"); }" />
